What Kimball Electronics says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: sales, operating income and capexAs part of today’s announcement, the Company reiterated its guidance for fiscal 2027 with net sales expected at the high end of the range of $1,535 - $1,560 million, adjusted operating income of 4.4% - 4.7% of net sales, and capital expenditures of $50 - $60 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
